suggested_requirements.text: The system shall secure data artifacts and the processes supporting the creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of information objects.
The system shall include self healing capabilities.
The system shall include self discovery capabilities.
The system shall define patterns of using new technologies to create interfaces with older systems.
The information model shall define common definitions of data concepts.
The information model shall allow aliases of data concepts.
The system shall use a reference architecture to create an enterprise information architecture.
The system shall model how semantic modeling supports information modeling.
The system shall define patterns of introducing business units to smart grid semantic modeling.
The system shall introduce data movement patterns to the organization.
The system shall introduce data movement tools and methodologies to the organization.
The system shall enhance the organization’s ability to create, maintain, and reuse logical data models.
